supplemental_evidence_records.reviewer_scope_facts: Publisher abstract describes closed-set generator classification and open-set rejection using passive diffusion latent signal-leaks, without modifying generator outputs. The synthetic face domain is explicitly retained.
supplemental_evidence_records.reviewer_notes: Publisher title, DOI, ordered authors, and technical abstract now independently verify the exact held identity and passive generator attribution. Resolve the disposition while retaining the October 3 HOLD row unchanged.

supplemental_evidence_records.title: Synthetic frequency patterns injection for data-agnostic deepfake detection
supplemental_evidence_records.reviewer_scope_facts: The publisher describes injecting crafted frequency patterns into pristine detector-training images and evaluating on 25 GAN/diffusion generators. This is detector augmentation, not watermark or provenance insertion into released generator outputs.
supplemental_evidence_records.reviewer_notes: Ordered authors and article identity verified against the cited primary bibliographic metadata. No affiliations or coordinates assigned.
